overview: The archaeological centre at Mikulcice preserves evidence of organized settlement, transport, fortification and churches associated with ninth-century Great Moravia.

items.text: The settlement occupied raised areas within the Morava floodplain. River channels shaped movement and defence.
Ninth-century rebuilding created a fortified core with timber, earth and a stone-facing wall.
Wooden bridges connected parts of the settlement; excavations recovered their remains in former channels.
Stone churches and burial grounds developed inside the acropolis, documenting changing religious and elite practices.

sources.title: Czech Ministry of Culture: Sites of Great Moravia, tentative-list submission
